ranking.attack: The central Botvinick--Tulving witness does not yet satisfy the manuscript's own trigger condition for a Representational Defeater. Treur independently motivates a family of temporal abstractions, but that is evidence for scientific motivation, not source-specific compatibility or liveness. The manuscript moves from 'independently motivated' to 'live alternative' without showing, source by source, that the coarse projection preserves the commitments whose evidential role is under dispute.
ranking.provenance_subattack: The reader-facing witness says the fine contrast is persistence+time-index versus history-window+time-index. Yet ATT03's source record explicitly contains an exponentially weighted preceding-trial history, while the journal-facing text does not expose why the selected ATT03 bounded witness is the persistence object; conversely, MEM04's source record foregrounds subjective temporal orientation and functional system distinction, so the provenance of its history-window witness is not locally obvious to a reviewer. This does not prove an error, but it makes the claimed source-compatible rival insufficiently inspectable.
ranking.current_defense_insufficient_because: A modeling precedent can make a transformation non-ad-hoc without making it admissible for these two source claims or for the individuation question at issue.
minimum_discharge: Provide a source-local witness table for Botvinick and Tulving separately: exact source commitment -> fine object -> forgotten distinction -> preserved commitment under CPCG.
State an inquiry purpose under which the forgotten persistence/history distinction is not assumed to be capacity-identity-relevant in advance.
Show that the coarse representation contradicts neither source claim at that stated purpose, while explicitly retaining the possibility that it is inferior for a different purpose.
If source compatibility cannot be established, stop calling this pair an instantiated Representational Defeater and downgrade it to a mathematical representation-sensitivity diagnostic.
do_not_do: Do not cite additional generic coarse-graining literature as a substitute for source-local compatibility.
Do not claim Treur establishes equivalence of the Botvinick and Tulving temporal organizations.

ranking.attack: The DR may be true but insufficiently independent. North already permits objective, non-pragmatic superiority among representations, while robustness-analysis literature already asks whether a result survives changes in model assumptions and whether apparent robustness confirms anything about the target. Brousalis already requires epistemically relevant similarities and differences. The manuscript may therefore redescribe a familiar rule: before using a model-dependent similarity as ontological evidence, justify that it tracks the target rather than the modeling choice.
ranking.circularity_subattack: The term 'discrimination' risks being defined extensionally by whatever extra evidence would justify the identity inference. If so, DR says little more than 'identity evidence must be adequate to justify identity.'
ranking.strongest_test: Produce a case in which R is independently and objectively superior for a legitimate scientific purpose, yet an invariant I exposed by R still lacks individuative warrant. If no such case is possible, North-style target-sensitive perspicuity may absorb the DR.
minimum_discharge: Add one explicit counterexample or thought experiment showing scientific representational superiority without individuative warrant for a particular invariant.
Index the two warrants to possibly different questions: adequacy/perspicuity for explanatory or predictive purpose versus relevance to the identity criterion.
State a non-circular failure condition for DR that can hold even when R is a good representation.
Explain why cross-representational robustness is one possible defeater-discharge route rather than the definition of DR itself.
ranking.candidate_counterexample_shape: A representation can be objectively superior for prediction because it compresses two mechanistically distinct processes into the same sufficient predictive state. The representation's predictive state may be genuinely perspicuous with respect to the predictive target while remaining non-individuative with respect to whether the two capacities are the same. The missing warrant concerns the identity relevance of the suppressed mechanistic distinction, not the scientific legitimacy of the predictive representation.
do_not_do: Do not answer only that 'representation justification is not identity-relevance justification'; demonstrate the separation.
Do not portray North as a rival to DR if North-style perspicuity can instead discharge it.

ranking.reviewer: General philosophy of science / cognitive ontology hostile reviewer
ranking.attack: The paper advertises cognitive-capacity individuation but directly analyzes source-grounded scientific claims. Its own four-term schema concedes that recurrence becomes capacity-identity evidence only after target alignment, bridge warrant, and representational discrimination. The corpus therefore does not establish capacity identity; it diagnoses conditions on promoting structural claim-level evidence. Once that concession is made, the 60-source corpus, 1,770 comparisons, bounded-reuse machinery, prospective study, role grammar, formal audits, and model replays can look disproportionate to a comparatively intuitive epistemic thesis.
ranking.genre_subattack: Because the quantitative machinery is explicitly denied population, reliability, and empirical-validation force, a hostile editor can ask why a shorter conceptual paper with one well-developed witness would not establish the same philosophical point more cleanly.
ranking.comparator_subattack: The 1,770/1,770 whole-claim incomparability result attracts attention while being explicitly classified as a failed-granularity diagnosis. Unless the main text briefly states the synthetic reachability controls showing the comparator can in fact return non-incomparable classes, readers may still suspect an over-discriminating comparator by construction.
minimum_discharge: Replace any remaining language that sounds like DR is a necessary condition on capacity identity simpliciter with 'a necessary evidential condition on structurally supported capacity-individuation inferences' or equivalent.
Make evidence-promotion, not capacity ontology, the explicit object of the central theorem-like claim.
Reduce the main-text role of corpus/replay/formal apparatus further; retain only the minimum needed to establish auditability and the central witness.
Promote a 2-3 sentence comparator reachability control to the main Methods/Results so 1,770/1,770 cannot be dismissed as comparator degeneracy.
Do not make independent human coding a condition of publication; if absent, preserve the current boundary statement.
do_not_do: Do not open a new large human-coding study merely to answer this reviewer.
Do not add more corpus counts to defend philosophical novelty.

editor_synthesis.rationale: A defensible reject decision can be built without alleging bad data or poor reproducibility. The strongest case is internal: the manuscript defines a live rival more strongly than its central witness currently demonstrates. The novelty challenge is next because nearby representation and robustness literatures can absorb the DR unless the two warrants are separated by an explicit counterexample. Scope/complexity is serious editorially but is not independently fatal.
m23_gate: G1: source-local Botvinick/Tulving fine-witness provenance and coarse source-compatibility audit
G2: explicit North-resistant counterexample demonstrating representational superiority without individuative warrant
G3: global wording audit: DR governs promotion of structural evidence to identity evidence, not identity simpliciter
G4: philosophy-first compression plus a short whole-claim comparator reachability paragraph
